header.running_head: The Noble Character of the Sahabah (RA)

blocks.text: resolute sense of modesty. When they speak to you, they can never be lying and when you speak to them, they will never regard you as a liar. They are Abu Bakr Siddeeq (RA), Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) and Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA)."[^1]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) said, "There are three men from the Quraysh who are the most handsome, have the best character and have the strongest sense of modesty. They are Abu Bakr (RA), Uthmaan (RA) and Abu Ubaydah (RA)."[^2]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Testifies to the Excellent Character of Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA)
Hadhrat Hasan reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said, "If I chose to do so, I could take each of my companions to task for aspects of their character except for Abu Ubaydah bin Jarraah (RA)."[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ says that the Character of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) is Closest to his Own

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Uthmaan Qurashi (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Uthmaan Qurashi (RA) that Rasulullaah ﷺ once visited his daughter as she was washing the head of (her husband) Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA). Addressing her, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Beloved daughter! Treat Abu Abdullaah (Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA)) well because from all my companions, his character is closest to my own."[^4]

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) reports that he once happened to go to Hadhrat Ruqayya (RA) who was the daughter of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the wife of Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA). She had a comb in her hand and she said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ just left me after I had combed his hair. 'How do you find Abu Abdullaah (Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA))?' he asked. When I replied that he was an excellent person, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'Look after him well because from all my companions, his character is closest to my own.'"[^5]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Comments about the Character of Hadhrat Ja'far (RA), Hadhrat Zaid (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA)
Hadhrat Abdullaah (RA) who was the son of Rasulullaah ﷺ's freed slave Aslam (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to Hadhrat Ja'far (RA), "You resemble me both in looks and in personality."[^6]
